steps.title: Prepare solutions and materials
steps.instruction:
Gather all reagents, supplies and equipment. Disinfect surgical tools and work surfaces with 70 % ethanol. Prepare the following solutions (store at 4 °C unless noted):
- HBSS dissociation solution (500 mL total): 490 mL HBSS (Thermo Fisher 14175095), 5 mL 1 % (v/v) HEPES (Thermo Fisher 15630080), 5 mL 1 % (v/v) Penicillin‑Streptomycin (Thermo Fisher 15140122).
- Papain solution (fresh, 3.108 mL total): 108 µL papain (≥16 U/mg, Sigma P3125) providing 40 U total, mixed with 3 mL HBSS dissociation solution.
- Collagenase stock (4.444 mL total, store at –20 °C): dissolve 100 mg collagenase (Sigma C6885) in 4.4 mL HBSS and add 44 µL 1 % HEPES to obtain 22.5 mg/mL.
- Collagenase working solution (3.0 mL total, use fresh): dilute 200 µL collagenase stock to 1.5 mg/mL with 2.8 mL HBSS.
- DMEM culture medium (500 mL total, store at 4 °C): 440 mL low‑glucose DMEM (Thermo Fisher 11885084), 50 mL heat‑inactivated FBS (Fisher MT35011CV, 10 % v/v), 5 mL Penicillin‑Streptomycin (1 % v/v), 5 mL Amphotericin B (1 % v/v, Thermo Fisher 15290026).
Prepare a 35 × 10 mm tissue culture dish with 4 mL HBSS dissociation solution, and two 1.7 mL microtubes each containing 1 mL HBSS dissociation solution. Keep dish and tubes on ice (4 °C). Keep papain, collagenase solutions and DMEM on ice until just before use, then warm papain, collagenase and DMEM to 37 °C.

steps.title: Anesthetize and euthanize mouse
steps.instruction: Place a CD1 mouse (6–12 weeks, Charles River 022) in a sealed jar. Add a gauze soaked with 1 mL isoflurane (Henry Schein 1182097) to the jar; the mouse will be anesthetized within ~1 min. Confirm deep anesthesia by lack of response to a pinch on the rear footpad. Decapitate the mouse in a sink to allow blood removal.

steps.title: Dissect dorsal root ganglia
steps.instruction:
In a designated dissection area, spray the mouse’s back fur liberally with 70 % ethanol. Perform the following steps under a stereomicroscope:
1. Make a transverse cut through the skin over the back and remove the skin.
2. Make two longitudinal cuts on each side of the vertebral column to expose the back muscles, then pull the muscles away using forceps from the rostral end.
3. Perform a laminectomy: cut the vertebral canal bones on both sides at a 45° angle with spring scissors, lifting the canal roof from rostral to caudal.
4. Remove the spinal cord rostral‑to‑caudal to expose the dorsal root ganglia (DRGs).
5. Using #5 forceps, grasp each dorsal root, pull a few millimetres, and cut the spinal nerve immediately distal to the ganglion with spring scissors.
6. Collect the DRGs, place them in the ice‑cold culture dish, and, if needed, trim away excess nerves, roots and connective tissue with spring scissors and #5 forceps.
7. Transfer the cleaned DRGs equally into the two prepared microtubes (≈20 ganglia per tube, up to ~40 per mouse).

steps.title: First enzymatic digestion (papain)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the microtubes at 200 × g for 1 min, discard the HBSS. Add 1.5 mL papain solution to each tube, gently flick to resuspend (do not pipette), and incubate 20 min in a 37 °C water bath. After incubation, centrifuge 200 × g for 1 min and discard papain solution. Wash the pellet with 1 mL HBSS, centrifuge 200 × g for 1 min, and discard the wash.

steps.title: Second enzymatic digestion (collagenase)
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL collagenase solution to each tube, gently flick to resuspend, and incubate 20 min at 37 °C in a still water bath (no vigorous shaking). Centrifuge 200 × g for 1 min and discard all collagenase solution.

steps.title: Mechanical dissociation and filtration
steps.instruction:
All subsequent manipulations are performed in a laminar‑flow hood.
1. Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL DMEM culture medium, centrifuge 200 × g for 1 min, and carefully remove the supernatant.
2. Resuspend the tissue in 0.5 mL DMEM culture medium.
3. Triturate with a P1000 pipette 15–20 times until the suspension appears cloudy (tissues should initially encounter slight friction, then pass easily; avoid bubbles).
4. Add 1 mL DMEM to each tube, then combine the contents of both tubes into a 50 mL conical tube.
5. Adjust the total volume to ~5 mL with DMEM, gently mix by flicking.
6. Filter sequentially through a 40 µm cell strainer then a 10 µm cell strainer, collecting the filtrate in a 50 mL tube each time.
7. If the filtrate volume is less than 5 mL, add DMEM to reach 5 mL and gently flick to resuspend cells.

steps.title: Plate cells and initiate culture
steps.instruction: Dispense 400 µL of the cell suspension into each well of a 12‑well plate that contains a sterilized cover glass. Place the plate in a CO₂ incubator set to 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. After 24 h, replace the medium with 400 µL fresh, pre‑warmed DMEM culture medium to remove debris. Thereafter, change the medium every 2–3 days. Cultures will reach confluence and display spindle‑shaped SGC morphology after 10–14 days.

steps.title: Immunofluorescence purity assay
steps.instruction:
At 10–14 days post‑plating, assess SGC purity as follows:
1. Replace medium with 4 % paraformaldehyde solution and incubate 15 min at room temperature (RT).
2. Rinse cultures with PBS.
3. Block with PBS containing 1 % BSA and 0.2 % Triton X‑100 (BSA solution).
4. Incubate overnight at 4 °C in the blocking solution containing anti‑glutamine synthetase primary antibody (rabbit, 1 : 5,000).
5. Next day, incubate 1 h at RT with anti‑rabbit Alexa Fluor 546 secondary antibody (1 : 1,000) in the same blocking solution.
6. Stain nuclei with DAPI in PBS for 1 min at RT.
7. Remove the cover glasses, mount them on glass microscope slides with Prolong Gold Antifade Mountant, and image using a Keyence BZ‑X800 microscope. Count GS⁺ cells versus DAPI⁺ cells to calculate purity.

steps.title: RNA extraction and qPCR analysis
steps.instruction:
At 10–14 days, perform transcriptional validation:
1. Remove medium and add TRIzol reagent to lyse the cells.
2. Extract total RNA using the Direct‑zol RNA MiniPrep kit.
3. Measure RNA concentration and purity with a UV‑Vis spectrophotometer.
4. Synthesize cDNA using a high‑capacity cDNA reverse transcription kit.
5. Set up qPCR reactions with PowerUp SYBR Green Master Mix on a QuantStudio 3 Real‑Time PCR System, using primers obtained from PrimerBank for target genes and Gapdh (reference).
6. Calculate relative expression ratios with the Pfaffl method.

steps.title: Calcium imaging functional assay
steps.instruction:
At 10–14 days, test functional response to an EDNRB agonist:
1. Replace medium and incubate cells 45 min at RT with 3 µg/mL Fura‑2 AM dissolved in DMEM containing 10 % FBS and 1 % P/S.
2. Remove cover glasses and place them in a recording chamber filled with external solution composed of 130 mM NaCl, 5 mM KCl, 2 mM CaCl₂, 1 mM MgCl₂, 30 mM glucose, and 10 mM HEPES.
3. Acquire fluorescence signals using a 365/385‑nm switching LED controlled by MetaFluor software on an Olympus BX51 microscope.
4. Apply IRL 1620 (10 nM), a selective EDNRB agonist, and record intracellular calcium transients.
5. Analyze traces to confirm calcium elevation in SGCs.
